from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
import logging

from app.auth import require_user
from app.schemas import OrderIn
from app.services import orders

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()
@router.post("/orders")
def place_order(payload: OrderIn, request: Request, user=Depends(require_user)):
    order = orders.create(user.id, payload.items)
    logger.info("Order %s placed from %s", order.id, request.client.host)
    return order

notes: A small orders route module with one authenticated endpoint that places orders.
